# roaringbuckets' JS client, vendored

The `.js` files are byte-for-byte copies of `packages/client/src/` in lokkju/roaringbuckets
at the tag and commit `../search-client.json` names (v0.3.0, the version stare-builder's
search build pins in `pipelines/search-index/uv.lock`), and `LICENSE` is that repository's
licence, PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. stare-builder's reference query (`../stare-search/`) reads
the search tree with it. Don't edit them; copy them in again at a new pin.
